method: All 14 pinned blobs read completely, with UTF16-BOM handling for requirements.txt. Eight Python files parsed as AST. External README illustration additionally decoded and visually inspected; it is not a commit-pinned tracked blob.
license_scope: Complete root Apache-2.0 LICENSE read. Third-party dependencies, model weights and external illustration rights not independently audited. Reference only; no production code adoption.

external_visual_review.observations: Historical Streamlit v0.0.7 screenshot: split beach-photo comparison with 1600x1200 versus 4032x3024 metadata, size filter enabled at 5, thumbnails, trash toggle and per-side delete buttons. Current source UI says v0.1.3 and uses FAISS controls; screenshot is not a current-runtime oracle.
external_visual_review.retention: Private ignored cache only; original URL and content hash retained, no image republished in repository.

executed_controls.kind: New defect-reproducer assertions, not original upstream tests or proof these behaviors are correct.
executed_controls.original_code_execution: db.py imported whole unchanged; selected original FunctionDef nodes compiled without modifying bodies. Original main/module initialization skipped to avoid ResNet model construction and network/UI effects.
executed_controls.adapters: Streamlit progress/message/button stub only. Real FAISS IndexFlatL2, NumPy arrays, Pillow images and SQLite temporary databases. No substitute nearest-neighbor algorithm.
cases: One actual FAISS vector with k=2 yields a missing-neighbor index accepted by negative Python indexing; persisted pair contains the same asset twice. Its distance exceeds 10 and is hidden by ordinary UI thresholds, so a visible default false positive is not claimed.
Three identical vectors produce only two unique candidate pairs, not all three possible pairs; nearest-two enumeration is not exhaustive all-pairs coverage.
Saving an existing pair with a new distance retains its old value.
Deleting the selected a-b pair leaves another a-c reference to the same removed asset. No real asset deletion performed.
Grayscale L input remains L, while RGBA converts to RGB; no full Torch transform/feature execution claimed.
Formatted size strings compare lexically: 10.000 MB is colored red relative to 2.000 MB.
Null exifInfo raises TypeError in original getAssetInfo rather than returning missing metadata.

source_findings: imageDuplicate.py runs a full pretrained ResNet152 classifier and flattens model output; no removal of classification head or normalization is present. No visual-quality calibration or model inference performed. README alternately mentions ResNet18/152.

FAISS index and object-array metadata are written directly as two files without generation ID, transaction or cardinality check. A partial write or reused ID can leave stale/inconsistent cache; failure injection was not run. Each asset update reloads and rewrites the whole cache pair, a source-level scale concern without a performance measurement.

Index reuse is keyed only by asset ID in metadata, with no content, server, model or preprocessing generation identity. Changing source content or server while reusing IDs has no invalidation mechanism in this source.

Pair persistence is insert-if-absent and retains prior similarity. Database IDs are asset strings despite INT column declarations; SQLite accepts them, as exercised in controls. There is no database uniqueness constraint; concurrent insertion was not qualified.

UI passes formatted size/resolution strings into general comparison helpers, loses numeric meaning and catches display failures with a broad missing-information message. API deletion payload uses force=True; code is read only and no requests were sent.

imageProcessing.py imports immichApi and faissCalc, neither present in the tree; videoDuplicate.py imports nonexistent api.getVideo. Current app imports imageDuplicate instead, and its video button only says Coming function, so these missing legacy imports are not claimed to break the main app.

requirements.txt has UTF16 encoding, pins most dependencies but leaves pillow-heif unpinned. Dockerfile clones the moving repository default without a commit and declares a curl-based healthcheck without explicitly installing curl; container build/runtime was not tested.

API retrieval uses legacy hardcoded routes, no pagination in fetchAssets, no streamed read bound for response.content and no timeout on image/download operations. Compatibility with current Immich endpoints is not asserted; no live service contacted.
Sidebar labels request timeout as milliseconds while forwarding the numeric value unchanged. API key is a regular text input and persisted in the settings table as text; no user credentials read.
No tracked test files or bundled image assets in the tree. Every Python file parses, which is syntax validation only.
limits: No full Streamlit UI, Immich API, Docker, Torch/torchvision, ResNet weights, image-quality corpus, video pipeline or performance qualification.
All fixture databases/files owned by TemporaryDirectory and cleaned; HTTP functions never invoked.
No production rrrah-dedup source change or accepted optimization; local-library existing gates remain separate.
Native pHash/ASAN remains deferred. Reviewing all repositories does not prove the library covers all cases.

evidence_storage.policy: -text preserves original CRLF/UTF16 bytes; -whitespace retains upstream formatting in this evidence directory only. No application source style checks changed.
